title: ThorImage TIFF files
description: A ThorImage recording, as dev's ThorLabsTiffs: a TIFF file per frame and channel (ChanA_001_001_001_0001.tif, ChanB_..., ...), matched by a file pattern with cardinality many. Each channel letter's files are its frames in natural order; with more than one channel the stack is height x width x channels x frames. Read a chunk at a time; read only.
